sections.title: 一、谁在中心
sections.body:
这城的中心不是城墙和黄金，而是使一切更新的那一位。
经文：示例书 1:1–10

evidence.english: The writer says the city had twelve gates and twelve foundations.
evidence.target: 作者说，这城有十二个门，十二个根基。

evidence.english: It is the one who makes all things new, and he is the one the whole story has been pointing to from the very first page until now.
evidence.target: 是那位使一切都更新的；从第一页到现在，整个故事一直指向他。

sections.title: 二、平凡的工作
sections.body: 因为他要更新万有，今天平凡的工作没有白费。

evidence.english: It means your ordinary work is not wasted.
evidence.target: 这意味着你平凡的工作没有白费。

sections.title: 默想
sections.body: 这一周，哪一件平凡的事让你觉得白费？把它带到那位更新一切的面前。

evidence.english: It is the one who makes all things new, and he is the one the whole story has been pointing to from the very first page until now.
evidence.target: 是那位使一切都更新的；从第一页到现在，整个故事一直指向他。

sections.title: 祷告
sections.body: 主啊，求你让我在平凡的工作里看见你的更新。

sections.title: 1. 중심에 계신 분
sections.body:
성의 중심은 성벽이나 금이 아니라 만물을 새롭게 하시는 분입니다.
본문: 예시서 1:1-10

evidence.english: The writer says the city had twelve gates and twelve foundations.
It is the one who makes all things new, and he is the one the whole story has been pointing to from the very first page until now.

sections.title: 2. 평범한 일
sections.body: 그분이 만물을 새롭게 하시기에 오늘의 평범한 일은 헛되지 않습니다.

evidence.english: It means your ordinary work is not wasted.

sections.title: 묵상
sections.body: 이번 주에 헛되다고 느낀 평범한 일은 무엇입니까?

evidence.english: It is the one who makes all things new, and he is the one the whole story has been pointing to from the very first page until now.

sections.title: 기도
sections.body: 주님, 평범한 일 속에서 주님의 새롭게 하심을 보게 하소서.

sections.title: 1. Quién está en el centro
sections.body:
El centro de la ciudad no son los muros ni el oro, sino aquel que hace nuevas todas las cosas.
Pasaje: Libro de ejemplo 1:1-10

evidence.english: The writer says the city had twelve gates and twelve foundations.
It is the one who makes all things new, and he is the one the whole story has been pointing to from the very first page until now.

sections.title: 2. El trabajo ordinario
sections.body: Porque él renueva todo, el trabajo ordinario de hoy no se pierde.

evidence.english: It means your ordinary work is not wasted.

sections.title: Meditación
sections.body: ¿Qué tarea ordinaria de esta semana te pareció en vano?

evidence.english: It is the one who makes all things new, and he is the one the whole story has been pointing to from the very first page until now.

sections.title: Oración
sections.body: Señor, ayúdame a ver tu renovación en mi trabajo ordinario.
